name: zklogin-prover

scripts.setup: npm run build && npm run setup-zkey && npm run export-vkey && mkdir -p keys && cp zklogin_myso_final.zkey build/zklogin_myso_final.zkey && cp zklogin_myso_final.zkey keys/zklogin_myso_final.zkey
scripts.setup-zkey: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 22 pot22_0000.ptau && snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot22_0000.ptau pot22_0001.ptau --name='Initial contribution' -v -e='random entropy' && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot22_0001.ptau pot22_final.ptau -v && snarkjs groth16 setup build/zklogin_myso.r1cs pot22_final.ptau zklogin_myso_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute zklogin_myso_0000.zkey zklogin_myso_final.zkey --name='Final contribution' -v -e='final random entropy'
scripts.export-vkey: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey zklogin_myso_final.zkey zklogin_myso_final.vkey.json
scripts.verify-build: ls -la build/ && ls -la build/zklogin_myso_js/ && echo 'Build verification complete'
scripts.dev: npm run build-production && npm run verify-files && PORT=3001 node server.js

description: Production-ready zkLogin proving service with RSA signature verification and real OAuth JWK integration
author: zkLogin Prover Team
